messages:
Ava: hey team! i'm Ava (frontend) — first day :wave:. trying to toggle a prod feature flag in Console and getting a 403 on /admin/flags. who should I ping for temporary flag admin or a JIT flow? thanks!

Devon: welcome @Ava! for staging you only need to be in the ff-developers SSO group. prod toggles are limited to ff-operators and require approval. do you need prod admin right away or can we do a canary toggle?

Ava: need prod to reproduce a QA failure. short-lived access (couple hours) is fine.

Rebecca: i can sponsor a JIT for a few hours. @Ava DM me the ticket id and a short rationale and i'll start the flow. note: all prod toggles are audited.

infra-bot: Request created: JIT-req-48321 by Rebecca — approve here: https://console.redwood.ai/jit/JIT-req-48321

Devon: tagging @Sam for a manual add if the JIT doesn't finish fast enough.

Sam: can do manual invite if needed. @Ava send me your ok + your org handle. also paste the exact curl or screenshot of the 403 so i can triage.

Ava: here's the curl i ran:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://console.redwood.ai/admin/flags/feature-foo -X PATCH -d '{"enabled":true}'
```
response: 403 {"error":"forbidden","code":"FF_NO_ACCESS"}

Rebecca: that's the enforced permission. starting the JIT now — you'll get a bot prompt for approval/MFA. what's the issue/ticket?

Ava: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/PROD-1245 — QA failing on payment checkout when flag is off.

infra-bot: JIT started: please approve via https://console.redwood.ai/jit/approve/JIT-req-48321

Ava: approved. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: JIT approved. Ava is in ff-operators for 4 hours. Audit id: audit-2026-03-22-ff-48321

Ava: i can toggle now, thanks everyone. i'll run the repro and then revert.

Devon: pro tip — prefer incremental rollout % where possible to limit blast radius.

Rebecca: thanks — @Ava pls add a short note in the ticket: why you needed prod access, actions taken, and revert time. that helps compliance.

Ava: will do. really appreciate the quick help :tada:
